correctness.rationale: The proof fixes all hypotheses and quantifiers, normalizes the circumcircle, derives signed half-plane formulas that equal the ordinary distances on the convex polygon, and observes that the target defect is affine in the point. At each vertex the two distance sums reduce exactly to a Dirichlet path quadratic form. The sharp path bound is the largest-eigenvalue formula for the tridiagonal path matrix, giving the claimed constant. The equality classification follows from the unique top eigenvector and the half-gap sum. A standalone deterministic checker independently evaluates the geometric formulas and inequalities on nonuniform polygons, but the finite checks are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The checked literature contains the exact 2016 all-polygon statement as a conjecture and the published triangle case, but no inspected source proves the general tangent-distance inequality. The proof here supplies a new implication route through affine reduction to vertices and the sharp Dirichlet path eigenvalue. The closest polygonal Erdős–Mordell theorem of Lenhard has a different left-hand quantity and therefore does not subsume the claim. Residual historical-synonym risk is recorded explicitly.
residual_risks: An equivalent proof may exist in older literature under polar-dual, support-line, or discrete Wirtinger terminology not surfaced by the searches.
The direct Forum Geometricorum PDF host was inaccessible in the web reader; a substantial reproduced text and independent bibliographic records were inspected instead.
The inspected conjecture page showing no answer is evidence of continued visibility as a question, not a proof of global novelty.

value.rationale: The result directly settles an explicitly posed 2016 all-polygon conjecture extending a published triangle theorem. It supplies the sharp constant, all interior equality cases, and a structural reduction to a classical path eigenvalue, so the contribution is a complete theorem rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or a routine restatement.
